result.stdout:
NetCraft mod development tools

Usage: ncm <tool> [options]

Tools:
  icon         Generate a white background mod icon with the mod name
  init         Create a new NetCraft mod project in a subdirectory
  template     Browse and pull mod templates
  build        Diagnose and build the mod project in the current directory
  asm          Inspect a .NET assembly: type list, type details, decompiled source, dependencies
  update       Check nuget.org and update ncm to the latest version

Run 'ncm help <tool>' to see the parameters of one tool.
